content.text: I found a PyTorch state-dict archive (`model.pth`) with a 784→16→16→10 MLP, but no Python ML packages or C compiler are installed. I’ll extract the weights into JSON using only the standard library, then build a dependency-free executable CLI that decodes PNGs and performs the MLP inference. The sample image is a white “2” on black, and the model predicts 2.
